entry.name: abl.dsp.quartz~
entry.description: Algorithmic Quartz reverb from Live's Hybrid Reverb device.

attributes.name: damping
attributes.digest: Damping
attributes.description: Controls the amount of filtering within the reverb algorithm. Higher values result in darker reverberation sounds. [0., 1.]

attributes.name: decay
attributes.digest: Decay
attributes.description: Adjusts the approximate time in seconds required for the algorithm's reverb tail to drop to 1/1000th (-60dB) of its initial amplitude. [0.1, 60.]

attributes.name: diffusion
attributes.digest: Diffusion
attributes.description: Controls the density of the algorithm's reverb tail. Low values produce sparser tails while higher values produce denser tails. [0., 1.]

attributes.name: distance
attributes.digest: Distance
attributes.description: Controls the virtual distance of reflections. Lower values place them closer to the listener and increase their density while higher values place them farther away and increase the time between echoes. [0., 1.]

attributes.digest: Common Max box / inspector attribute (shared across objects; not necessarily listed in this object’s refpage XML).

attributes.digest: Common Max box / inspector attribute (shared across objects; not necessarily listed in this object’s refpage XML).

attributes.digest: Common Max box / inspector attribute (shared across objects; not necessarily listed in this object’s refpage XML).

attributes.name: freeze
attributes.digest: Freeze reverb tail
attributes.description: Sets the algorithm's decay time to infinity so that reverberation will sustain endlessly. Freezing begins when this attribute is enabled and ends when disabled, so you will most likely want to toggle this attribute while audio is being processed for it to take effect.

attributes.name: freezein
attributes.digest: Add incoming signal to the frozen reverb tail
attributes.description: When enabled, new input signals are added to the frozen reverberation. When disabled,will endlessly sustain the output of the reverb, and any additional input signals will not be processed untilis turned off and then back on. This attribute is disabled by default.

attributes.name: ins
attributes.digest: Control Inlets
attributes.description: Declares additional inlets that can be used to control float-type attributes at either event or signal rate. Any declared attributes already mapped to inlets will be ignored. This attribute can only be set when the object is instantiated.

attributes.digest: Common Max box / inspector attribute (shared across objects; not necessarily listed in this object’s refpage XML).

attributes.name: low_damping
attributes.digest: Low Damping
attributes.description: Controls the amount of low frequency filtering within the reverb algorithm. Higher values result in brighter reverberation sounds. [0., 1.]

attributes.name: mix
attributes.digest: Dry/wet
attributes.description: Sets the dry/wet mix of the output signal. [0., 1.]

attributes.name: mod
attributes.digest: Modulation Amount
attributes.description: Controls the amount of movement within the algorithm's reverb tail. Less modulation produces less movement, and more modulation adds more movement with a chorusing effect. [0., 1.]
